name: Turkey Breast
siboNotes: Plain turkey breast is excellent for SIBO as it's protein-rich and FODMAP-free. Avoid processed varieties with added onion or garlic powder.
preparationTips: Choose plain, unseasoned turkey breast to avoid hidden FODMAPs
Check deli meat labels for garlic powder, onion powder, or high-fructose corn syrup
Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like oregano, thyme, or rosemary
Roast with olive oil and safe spices for meal prep
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially niacin and B6
Good source of selenium and phosphorus
Low in saturated fat compared to other meats
